description: Authored dev mods that are git-tracked here (so a clean build cannot erase them) and copied into <install>/mods on every build by devtools/build-headless.ps1. Each entry's source lives at dev-mods/<path>/. Per-mod 'dev' and 'release' flags control default inclusion; override at build time with -DevMods all|none|<comma-list>, or at release time with the release script's mod flags.

mods.summary: Halo-Needler-style custom weapon: tracking primary needles, non-tracking explosive secondary with small pink contact explosions.
